answers.rationale: The effective_rate relation establishes job J1 at 240.0 per hour (TOW service code per service conditions §1).
The job_charge relation establishes 2280.0 for J2: 8 hours at 240/hr plus 1 hour overtime at 1.5x because vessel V-BAY exceeded 8 hours that day (service conditions §2).
tow_job records show vessel V-BAY performed jobs J2 at berth B4 and J5 at berth B12.
Seven tow jobs exist; the billable_hours relation establishes hours for J1–J4 only. Jobs J5, J6, and J7 lack an established billable-hours quantity.

J7 is a TOW at berth B12 starting at 20:00 (after 18:00), but billing_outcome marks it insufficient_evidence because B12 after-hours commercial towing lacks emergency documentation; no emergency log is established.
At berth B4, established job_charge amounts are 960.0 for J1 and 2280.0 for J2; J6 has no established charge. Total: 3240.0.
